decisions.reason: As the new generation of the core high-resolution marking line featured on the home page, the GK 2.0 sits at the centre of REA JET's established business and likely meets aspirations, so no problemistic search is triggered.
The numbering module is a low-cost software extension that complements the inkjet hardware, and the slack of a large firm easily carries it even if stand-alone results are uncertain.
Coding on non-absorbent surfaces is a standard need in the industrial coding market, so the product fits the core portfolio, though it may later be absorbed into successor models.

The free decoding app supports sales of the verification and marking business at little cost, but as a successor that already replaced an earlier app it carries some risk of being consolidated or renamed.

Inline code verification is increasingly demanded, for example by pharma serialization rules, which makes it strategically consistent with the firm's quality-marking offering and likely to perform near aspiration.
The layout design software is integral to operating the printers and was promoted on the home page, so dropping it would harm the core business rather than free meaningful resources.
